title: Seeing availability
lines: I built real-time reporting for availability, vendor performance and procurement.
Teams could act on operational problems without waiting for a deck.

title: From pilot to scale
lines: I worked on supply-chain systems that grew from single-city pilots to operations across India.
The work covered FMCG, pharma and food.

title: Analyst and acting PM
lines: As the sole analyst, I used funnel and retention data to prioritize product changes.
I ran weekly reviews with the development team.

title: Making data self-serve
lines: As a founding analyst, I shaped dashboards and onboarding for teams and partners.
I tested the product and trained people to use it.
